text: Video Message from the Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar@MIshaqDar50on the Occasion of the 80th Independence Day of Pakistan (14 August 2026)
translated_text: 副总理兼外交部长参议员 Mohammad Ishaq Dar@MIshaqDar50 在巴基斯坦第 80 个独立日之际发表的视频致辞（2026 年 8 月 14 日）

text: On the 80th Independence Day of Pakistan, we celebrate the spirit of Freedom, Unity and Resilience that continues to define our Nation. On this day, we honour the sacrifices of those who made our freedom possible and renew our commitment to Pakistan’s progress, prosperity, unity
translated_text: 在巴基斯坦独立 80 周年之际，我们庆祝自由、团结和坚韧的精神，这种精神继续定义着我们的国家。在这一天，我们向那些使我们的自由成为可能的人们致敬，并重申我们对巴基斯坦进步、繁荣和团结的承诺

text:
On Pakistan’s 80th Independence Day, we honour the vision, courage and sacrifices of all our founding leaders and Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah, as well as the generations who struggled and sacrificed for the creation and progress of Pakistan.

This day is a reminder of both
translated_text:
在巴基斯坦独立第 80 日之际，我们向所有开国领导人和奎德·阿扎姆·穆罕默德·阿里·真纳以及为巴基斯坦的创建和进步而奋斗和牺牲的几代人的远见、勇气和牺牲表示敬意。

这一天对双方来说都是一个提醒

text:
Heartfelt congratulations to all Pakistanis at home and abroad on Independence Day from the depths of my heart!

On this joyous occasion marking the 79th anniversary of Pakistan's independence, I extend my heartfelt felicitations to all compatriots. A hundred praises to Almighty
translated_text:
值此独立日之际，我向国内外全体巴基斯坦人民致以衷心的祝贺！

值此巴基斯坦独立79周年的喜庆时刻，我向全体同胞致以衷心的祝贺。向全能者一百个赞美

text: Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif participated in and addressed the inauguration ceremony of the Monument of Victory, a symbol of national unity, solidarity, and resolute commitment to the defense of the homeland. President of the country Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister
translated_text: 穆罕默德·谢赫巴兹·谢里夫总理参加了胜利纪念碑落成典礼并致辞，该纪念碑象征着民族团结、团结和保卫祖国的坚定承诺。国家总统阿西夫·阿里·扎尔达里和总理

text: On August 14th, as the Great Nation of Pakistan celebrates the 79th Auspicious Anniversary of Independence, on behalf of myself, Government and Nation of the Islamic Republic of Iran, I extend my Warmest Greetings to the Government & Nation of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
translated_text: 8 月 14 日，在伟大的巴基斯坦庆祝独立 79 周年之际，我谨代表我个人、伊朗伊斯兰共和国政府和民族，向巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国政府和民族致以最热烈的问候。
